segments.ja430:1.1: Santi rukkhā haripattā [haritapattā (sī. syā. pī.)], dumā nekaphalā bahū;
segments.ja430:1.3: Kasmā nu sukkhe [sukkha (ka.)] koḷāpe, suvassa nirato mano.
segments.ja430:2.3: Aphalampi viditvāna, sāva metti yathā pure.
segments.ja430:3.3: Ohāya sakuṇā yanti, kiṃ dosaṃ passase dija.
segments.ja430:4.1: Ye phalatthā sambhajanti, aphaloti jahanti naṃ;
segments.ja430:5.1: Sādhu sakkhi kataṃ hoti, metti saṃsati santhavo;
segments.ja430:6.1: So te suva varaṃ dammi, pattayāna vihaṅgama;
segments.ja430:6.3: Varaṃ varassu vakkaṅga, yaṃ kiñci manasicchasi.
segments.ja430:7.1: Api nāma naṃ passeyyaṃ [api nāma naṃ puna passe (sī. syā.)], sapattaṃ saphalaṃ dumaṃ;
segments.ja430:9.1: Evaṃ sakka sukhī hohi, saha sabbehi ñātibhi;
segments.ja430:10.1: Suvassa ca varaṃ datvā, katvāna saphalaṃ dumaṃ;
segments.ja430:10.3: Pakkāmi saha bhariyāya, devānaṃ nandanaṃ vananti.
